# adds_subnet (Resource)

Manages a CIDR network assigned to an Active Directory replication site. Clients use their IP address and these subnet assignments to discover their local domain controllers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "adds_site" "headoffice" {
  name = "HeadOffice"
}

resource "adds_subnet" "headoffice_lan" {
  name        = "10.42.0.0/16"
  site        = adds_site.headoffice.name
  description = "Head office LAN"
  location    = "Oslo, Norway"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Subnet in CIDR notation, for example `10.42.0.0/16`. Changing it replaces the subnet.
- `site` (String) Site assigned to this subnet, by name or distinguished name. Changing it updates the assignment in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Subnet description.
- `location` (String) Physical location of the subnet.

### Read-Only

- `distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of the replication subnet.
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier. Equals the subnet distinguished name.
